summary: When students ask me for a list of assignments they are missing I will politely refuse, and ask them to go through syllabus and provide ME with the list, and offer to sit and make the list with them. Am I being unfair? harsh? #digped
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: When students ask me for a list of assignments they are missing I will politely refuse, and ask them to go through syllabus and provide ME with the list, and offer to sit and make the list with them. Am I being unfair? harsh? #digped
